english:
our [Holy Fathers] John of Odzun, John of Orotan, and Gregory of Tatev.
Morning Hymn Tone 1 [AK]: "Who adorned..." with its proper [canons].
In the Morning (Mankunk) Tone 3 [GY]: "O Lord, resembling Moses."
Midday Liturgy
Patristic Hymn Tone 3 [GY]: "The leaders and teachers."
Psalm: "Let your priests."
Proverbs 20:6: "A man is great..." to verse 22: "...that He may be your helper."
Prophet Jeremiah 4:21: "Be encouraged..." to verse 24: "...unto the everlasting."
Epistle 2 Corinthians 4:1: "Therefore having..." to verse 11: "...in our mortal flesh."
Alleluia: "You are a priest."
Gospel John 9:39: "And Jesus said..." to chapter 10:10: "...and have it more abundantly."
In the Evening, Evening Hymn (Hambartsi) Tone 7 [E3]: "Who created the day."

Fourth Sunday of Great Lent.
Morning Hymn Tone 3 [D3]: "Who created..." with its proper [canons].
Psalm 112 [113] Antiphon: "Let the name of the Lord be blessed."
Gospel Luke 12:32: "Do not fear..." to verse 48: "...they will demand of him."
Midday Liturgy
Psalm Antiphon: "Praise is due to you."
Prophet Isaiah 56:1: "Thus says the Lord: Keep..." to chapter 57:21: "...the wicked, says the Lord."
Psalm 75 [76]: "Make vows and [perform them]."
Epistle Ephesians 4:17: "Now this I say..." to chapter 5:14: "...Christ."
Alleluia: "Shout with joy to the Lord."
Gospel Luke 16:1: "And He said also to the disciples..." to verse 31: "...they will [not] believe."

Monday.
Patristic Hymn Tone 3 [GY]: "Glorified."
Midday Liturgy, Gradual Psalm 50 [51]: "Restore to me, O Lord."
Prophet Jeremiah 32:19: "Almighty, great of name Lord..." to verse 44: "...their captivity, says the Lord."

Tuesday.
Patristic Hymn Tone 3 [GY]: "Glorified is."
Midday Liturgy, Gradual Psalm 127 [128]: "Blessed are all."
Book of Job 38:1: "Who is this that hides..." to chapter 39:36: "...I will not add."

Wednesday.
Patristic Hymn Tone 3 [GY]: "God of our fathers."
Midday Liturgy, Gradual Psalm 37 [38]: "Do not forsake me."
Book of Exodus 3:16: "Now go and gather..." to verse 22: "...the Egyptians."
Prophet Joel 3:1: "For behold, I am..." to verse 8: "...for the Lord has spoken."
Psalm 76 [77]: "I cry aloud with my voice..." read to the end.

Thursday.
Patristic Hymn Tone 3 [GY]: "Blessed are you, Lord."
Midday Liturgy, Gradual Psalm 70 [71]: "Do not cast me off."
Epistle 1 Corinthians 8:5: "For although there may be..." to chapter 9:23: "...I might become with him."

Friday.
Patristic Hymn Tone 4 [GD]: "God most high."
Midday Liturgy, Gradual Psalm 118 [119]: "Let my supplication come near."
Book of Deuteronomy 9:11: "And it came to pass after..." to verse 23: "...the voice of the Lord."
Book of Job 16:1: "I have heard such..." to chapter 17:16: "...we shall go down into the dust."
Prophet Isaiah 48:22: "There is no..." to chapter 49:8: "...but apart from me."

Saturday. The Holy Forty Infants who were martyred in Sebastia.
Morning Hymn Tone 8 [GK]: "Today with the bodiless..." with its proper [canons].
Midday Liturgy, Psalm 65 [66]: "We went through fire."
Proverbs (Wisdom of Solomon) 3:1: "But the souls of the righteous..." to verse 8: "...the Lord forever."
Prophet Nahum 2:1: "Strengthen with power..." to verse 4: "...and they run beyond."
Prophet Isaiah 43:1: "And now thus says..." to verse 3: "...who saves you."
Epistle Ephesians 6:10: "Finally, be strong..." to verse 18: "...at all times."
Alleluia: "We went through."
Gospel Matthew 13:43: "Then the righteous..." to verse 52: "...and the old."
In the Evening, Evening Hymn (Hambartsi) Tone 4 [BK]: "The commandment."

Fifth Sunday of Great Lent.
Morning Hymn Tone 4 [BK]: "The commandment..." with its proper [canons].
Psalm 112 [113]: "Let the name of the Lord be blessed."
Gospel Mark 13:1: "And as He came out..." to verse 37: "...keep watch."
Midday Liturgy
Psalm Antiphon: "Praise is due to you."
Prophet Isaiah 65:8: "Thus says the Lord: As..." to verse 25: "...my holy [mountain], says the Lord."
Gradual Psalm 75 [76]: "Make vows."
Epistle Philippians 3:1: "Finally, my brothers..." to chapter 4:9: "...shall be with you."
Alleluia: "Shout with joy."
Gospel Luke 17:20: "Being asked..." to chapter 18:11: "...shall be exalted."

Monday.
Patristic Hymn Tone 8 [DZ]: "God of our fathers."
Midday Liturgy, Gradual Psalm 50 [51]: "Restore to me."
Epistle Hebrews 1:1: "In many parts..." to verse 14: "...salvation."

Tuesday.
Patristic Hymn Tone 7 [D3]: "God of our fathers."
Midday Liturgy, Gradual Psalm 127 [128]: "Blessed are all."
Prophet Isaiah 8:5: "And the Lord spoke again..." to verse 10: "...the Lord God is."
